answer: Require each transaction to gather attestations from K independent peers who share no referral edge with the sender. A ring of clones can color its own work one saffron shade, but like a lone pigment it cannot reproduce the whole spectrum; pass the light through a prism and the missing bands expose it. Finality lands only when unrelated graders — never the sender's own copies — sign off, so self-certified sybils never reach it.
